detail.description: summary (default) returns totals and fee lines; full returns the complete REST response.

estimated_sales_tax.description: Sales tax collected from the buyer, in USD (some marketplaces charge fees on it). Default 0.

fulfillment_date.description: amazon_fba only: ship date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the FBA rate card. Defaults to today (UTC). Range 2026-01-15 to 2027-10-14.

item_cost.description: Seller's cost of the item, in USD. Default 0.

marketplace.description: amazon_fbm = Amazon (Fulfilled by Merchant); amazon_fba = Amazon (Fulfilled by Amazon); walmart = Walmart Marketplace; walmart_wfs = Walmart Marketplace (Walmart Fulfillment Services); ebay = eBay; tiktok_shop = TikTok Shop (US); etsy = Etsy; facebook_marketplace = Facebook Marketplace; poshmark = Poshmark; mercari = Mercari; depop = Depop (US); stockx = StockX (Verified Marketplace)

options.description: Marketplace-specific options (e.g. ebay store_subscription, etsy offsite_ads_percent). See list_marketplaces for names and values.

other_costs.description: Other per-item costs (packaging, ads, etc.), in USD. Default 0.

package.description: Packaged unit dimensions (inches) and unit weight (pounds), used to determine the fulfillment size tier, dimensional weight (L x W x H / 139) and shipping weight. Required for amazon_fba and walmart_wfs.

sale_price.description: Item price the buyer pays, in USD, excluding shipping and tax.

shipping_charged.description: Shipping the buyer pays, in USD. Default 0.

shipping_cost.description: Seller's shipping label cost, in USD. Default 0.
